description: Every heatmap your dates can make, in one visual. Drop in a date and a measure and get a GitHub-style year strip with weekly totals, a weekday profile and a one-line insight. Switch to a wall-calendar month grid, or to a matrix heatmap that turns the same date/time column into a weekday x hour punch card - or maps any two fields, no dates needed. Knows the calendars businesses report in. Fiscal years with any start month, retail 4-4-5 / 4-5-4 / 5-4-4 years with 52/53 weeks, ISO or "1 January = week 1" week numbers, weeks starting Monday, Sunday or Saturday, and public holidays for 21 countries computed offline. Date hierarchies work as-is. Free features: Year strip, month grid with click-to-zoom, matrix heatmap (weekday x hour, weekday x month, year x month, month x day, weekday x week, or any two fields) % of row / column / total, row and column totals, sparkline margins (weekday profile, weekly totals) Linear, quantile, log and manual-threshold scales, diverging centres, fixed min/max, smart range, 10 palettes incl. colour-blind-safe viridis and cividis, report theme colour 4 themes with their own personality: rounded tiles, dark glow, editorial squares, dot matrix KPI line, insight sentence, longest streak, notes and holidays from your data, today marker Cross-filtering, Ctrl multi-select, drill-through menu, report-page tooltips, keyboard navigation, high contrast,…
